en.headline: Labour Department tests infrared drones to enforce construction site smoking ban
en.dek: Officials have issued 39 fixed-penalty notices and 11 advisories since the ban took effect on 17 July, describing compliance as unsatisfactory and exploring AI-assisted detection.
body: The Labour Department said on Wednesday it is testing small drones equipped with infrared thermal imaging cameras to detect smoking on construction sites, after describing the number of prosecutions under the new ban as unsatisfactory.

Since the comprehensive smoking ban took effect on 17 July, officers have conducted about 1,400 site inspections and issued 39 fixed-penalty notices of HK$3,000 each, plus 11 improvement notices to contractors who failed to take all reasonable steps to prevent smoking. The department is considering prosecution in two further cases.

Assistant Commissioner for Labour (Occupational Safety) Wan Chi-ping said the drones can be calibrated to flag heat sources in the 60–80°C range that may indicate smoking. When a red dot appears on the monitoring screen, ground teams can gather further evidence and take enforcement action. The department is also studying the integration of artificial intelligence for image analysis, with research expected to take nine months to a year.

Between October 2025 and July 2026 the department carried out 64 drone-assisted enforcement operations that led to more than 220 prosecutions, mostly for failures to implement proper measures for working at height and unsafe lifting. Wan said the technology helps overcome geographical limitations and allows remote monitoring without alerting people on site.

zh.headline: 勞工處試用紅外線無人機巡查地盤禁煙
zh.dek: 禁煙令7月17日生效後已發出39張定額罰款通知書及11張敦促改善通知書，當局指合規情况未如理想，並研究結合人工智能偵測。
body: 勞工處周三表示，正測試配備紅外線熱感應鏡頭的小型無人機，協助巡查建築地盤禁煙情况，並指目前檢控數字未如理想。
全面禁煙法例自7月17日生效以來，當局巡查約1,400個地盤，發出39張每張3,000元的定額罰款通知書，以及11張敦促改善通知書予未有採取所有合理步驟防止吸煙的承建商，另正考慮就兩宗個案提出檢控。
勞工處助理處長（職業安全）溫治平表示，無人機可調校熱感應範圍，例如將攝氏60至80度設為懷疑吸煙熱點。屏幕出現紅點後，地面人員可進一步蒐證及執法。當局亦研究結合人工智能影像分析技術，預計需時約9個月至一年。
去年10月至今年7月，勞工處以小型無人機進行64次執法行動，提出超過220項檢控，大部分涉及未有採取適當高空工作措施及不安全吊運作業。溫治平指科技有助克服地理限制，並可在不驚動現場人士的情况下進行遙距監察。
